info.title: nb1 local device execution API
info.description: Local implementation snapshot; this documentation does not announce a release. HTTP is loopback-only, without user authentication; non-local Host values and cross-origin browser control are rejected. Use canonical lowercase field names. Strict decoders reject unknown or incorrectly cased fields, duplicate object keys, explicit null, trailing JSON, and nesting beyond their limits; newer codecs have additional numeric and Unicode rules that must not be generalized to every legacy route. Legacy low-level Program may omit default fields and normalizes repeat=0 to 1; Frame HTTP and authored Action define their own omission and explicit-zero rules. Optional request_id/expected_daemon_instance_id bindings deduplicate only within bounded receipts in the same daemon instance. Legacy submissions need no preparation step; clients do not retry automatically, and no exactly-once guarantee survives a restart. The daily 1d89 and development f8bb267 labels in x-availability are historical source baselines. The installed workspace baseline is 96a1f92a8a2fcf836129797e4c3a82602a4e7ffc, integrating the 44 canonical HTTP operations, P4 identity admission, P5 source resolver, P6 fixed-Ref preview/submit/query/cancel, and independent lazy-default v2 library; installed status is separately recorded in x-availability. Four explicit GET aliases bring this OpenAPI snapshot to 48 operations across 43 paths, with 111 models. Three static resources depend on the embedded bundle profile. JSON Schema checks structure, not hashes/source correspondence, raw numeric spelling, duplicate-key absence, Unicode scalar validity, device support, or physical effects. Installed 96a has seven advanced CLI commands and MCP16. Later source candidates add CLI list (eighth command), MCP20 authoring, transport diagnostics, and an English Web bundle; discover the installed interface before using them.

post.summary: Submit an exact Program or a finite legacy Effect
post.description: An HTTP disconnect does not cancel the Job. No automatic USB fallback or Flash/device-mode write. The optional pair enables bounded same-instance deduplication: initial admission and replay both return 202 with the original Job current state; failed/cancelled Jobs are not executed again. An unkeyed call retains the legacy behavior of creating a new Job each time. program/effect are exclusive; steady/pulse compile to a normal Program before entering the same queue, receipts, and cleanup. Job.program contains the expanded result. The pattern_ref branch requires explicit reject and a complete original ticket, resolves the frozen Program, and uses the same executor. An invalid reference does not prove the original ticket never executed; query its original receipt rather than resubmitting with another ticket.
